rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload condition when X13 opens.
Reset latched cell fault M190 via fault reset pushbutton X1.
Evaluate summary fault M199 from latched fault, overload, or E-stop inactive.
Drive conveyor motor contactor Y10 in auto mode when no fault is present.
Set pallet in position status M100 from stop photo-eye X10.
Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of line controller release request.
Time stopper release duration (2.0 s) using timer T11.
Unlatch stopper release solenoid Y11 when pulse timer T11 expires.
